candidate_assessments.overlap_with_current_o: O already has immutable evidence bundles, provenance checks, and fail-closed AGI evidence, but ordinary research/Candidate evaluation can still over-weight polished summaries relative to executable workspace evidence.
candidate_assessments.active_uncertainty_resolution: Tests whether O evaluators actually reconcile claims against source code/log/result artifacts and whether typed integrity violations control the decision rather than merely appearing in prose.
candidate_assessments.rationale: The highest-value transfer is the access pattern and decision coupling: inspect immutable artifacts read-only, reconcile reported numbers/methods/figures/references, and make concrete integrity violations blocking where appropriate. Do not treat the LLM artifact reviewer itself as a truth oracle.
candidate_assessments.scope: ResearchArena artifact-aware reviewers remain model-based and can over-credit relative to humans; cross-agent score differences are confounded.

candidate_assessments.overlap_with_current_o: O has recursive Evaluate/Learn/Candidate revision, but does not assume each revision operator has equal value across semantic stages.
candidate_assessments.active_uncertainty_resolution: Whether critique/refinement budget should be routed differently across idea, experiment, implementation, evaluation, and report stages.
candidate_assessments.rationale: Measure downstream endpoint lift and elapsed cost for refinement by stage, then disable or replace revision loops that are neutral/degradative. ResearchArena stage scores are not randomized external endpoints, so use them only to motivate the O-local ablation.
candidate_assessments.scope: Threshold-triggered stage revisions; not randomized no-refinement causal evidence.

candidate_assessments.overlap_with_current_o: O already optimizes elapsed time/cost and tracks bottlenecks; this adds a concrete precondition before expensive compute scaling.
candidate_assessments.active_uncertainty_resolution: Whether a poor research outcome is compute-limited or design/evidence-limited before increasing resource allocation.
candidate_assessments.rationale: Require a bounded matched scaling diagnostic or bottleneck argument before spending materially more compute; resource scaling is a Candidate, not an assumed universal accelerant.
candidate_assessments.scope: Eight Codex GPU-domain seeds; does not imply compute is generally useless.

candidate_assessments.overlap_with_current_o: O binds observations/provenance and can inspect source artifacts, but the separate evaluator action of actively executing adversarial/off-distribution probes is not established as a generic evaluation stage.
candidate_assessments.active_uncertainty_resolution: Whether static artifact inspection and trajectory review miss conditional/data-hidden failures that only appear under targeted execution probes.
candidate_assessments.rationale: For executable O Candidates/results, compare trajectory-only, static-artifact, and executable-probe access at equal evaluation targets. Log the exact probes run. Candidate rationale should be a separately randomized context input because it can interfere with independent detection.
candidate_assessments.scope: Sabotage benchmark; detection is not identical to scientific-quality evaluation. Detailed pooled table values in the worker record include mirror-derived evidence.

candidate_assessments.overlap_with_current_o: O has falsification/evaluation machinery but no explicit bounded search over adversarial/metamorphic tests for each executable artifact is documented.
candidate_assessments.active_uncertainty_resolution: Addresses the failure mode where an evaluator has full tools/artifacts yet never executes the decisive test.
candidate_assessments.rationale: Create a bounded Candidate for hypothesis-directed probe generation, but do not promote it as proven: ResearchArena establishes the missing-probe failure, not causal benefit of a specific probe generator. Evaluate added detection/useful failure discovery, false positives, cost, and downstream Candidate decisions against artifact access alone.
candidate_assessments.scope: Strong failure evidence, weak causal evidence for a particular probe-search algorithm.
